parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the wheel of the cart, made of rubber, typically circular with a diameter of around 25 cm. It belongs to the rolling component category.
parts.Functional_description: The wheel allows the cart to move smoothly and supports the load during transportation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axle to enable forward and backward motion of the cart.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the cart, made of steel, forming the main structure and handles. It measures approximately 100 cm in length and 60 cm in width.
parts.Functional_description: The base body supports the load and provides handles for the user to lift and maneuver the cart.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the wheel, serving as the main frame that transfers force to the wheel during movement.
